title: wss: rate limit cross-refs cite JMAP-CHAT instead of JMAP-CHAT-FED
description: Two cross-references in draft-atwood-jmap-chat-wss-00 are wrong. §5.3 says 'consistent with the Peer/typing rate limit defined in JMAP-CHAT'. §5.4 says 'consistent with the Peer/subscribePresence delivery rate defined in JMAP-CHAT'. Both Peer/typing and Peer/subscribePresence are defined in JMAP-CHAT-FED (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-federation-00), not in the main JMAP-CHAT draft. Fix: update both references to cite JMAP-CHAT-FED.
close_reason: Added JMAP-CHAT-FED as a normative reference; fixed both wrong citations in §5.3 (Peer/typing) and §5.4 (Peer/subscribePresence) from {{JMAP-CHAT}} to {{JMAP-CHAT-FED}}.
